meta.parties: Hamid v. Colombo Apothecaries Company Limited

rules.statement: A judge may form the opinion that a transfer of property was made with intent to defeat or delay creditors, even if no specific evidence is presented in court.
rules.supporting_quote: "The simple position therefore is whether the admitted facts disclose acts of insolvency. A man is presumed to intend the natural consequences of his acts. The admitted acts are capable of more than one construction and no argument was addressed to the Judge to show that his view of them was wrong."
